name: Wakestone Gargoyle
oracle_text:
Defender, flying
{1}{W}: Creatures you control with defender can attack this turn as though they didn't have defender.
blocked_sentences: {1}{W}: Creatures you control with defender can attack this turn as though they didn't have defender.

needs.what: a one-shot op with a duration (this_turn) that lets the selected permanents (creatures you control with defender, locked in at resolution) attack as though they lacked defender, while they keep the defender keyword for every other purpose (selectors, counts, 'creatures with defender' anthems)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No op or static_effect relaxes the defender attack restriction. lose_keyword actually removes defender, which changes what 'with defender' selectors and statics see (e.g. a 'creatures with defender get +X' anthem would stop applying), so it is a different card; must_attack/attacks_if_able force attacks rather than permit them
